method.recruitment: Caller explicitly selected actual participation; one self-selected participant, not a representative sample.
method.response_collection: Interactive ask questions, with inability/partial/screen-unavailable choices and an automatically supplied free-text option. All successful comprehension claims would require substantive participant answers and actual observation; none is inferred.
method.neutral_prompts: Japanese translations of the existing validation-plan.md prompts. No correct answer or corrective guidance was supplied during UX01–UX08. The examiner selected fixture candidate B before UX02–UX04 as scenario setup, not as a participant action.
method.capture_scope: Fresh read-only native accessibility and window captures retained privately at each relevant endpoint. Final states are not a full action trace. No image is claimed unique or sufficient by itself to prove a new execution.
method.timing: First-view onset and comprehension latency were not independently measured. The participant selected 時間は不明. No five-second PASS or five-second FAIL is claimed.
method.environment: Windows native prototype; no display/contrast/permission setting changed and no full DPI, assistive-technology or product matrix claimed.

checks.prompt: このタスクは、いま何をしていますか？画面から理解した内容を自由入力で教えてください。
この画面で、作業中の成果物はどこにありますか？場所や見えているものを自由入力で教えてください。
checks.actual_media_dominance: NOT_MEASURED: the prototype has no actual media renderer.

checks.prompt: 候補（Candidate）とIterationは、どのような関係だと理解しましたか？自由入力で教えてください。
現在選ばれている候補はどれで、それは最終選択ですか？理解した内容を自由入力で教えてください。
この候補がこのように評価された理由と、その裏付けを画面で示してください。操作後、たどった場所と分かった内容を自由入力で教えてください。
checks.observation: The endpoint accessibility tree has Evidence details open for viewed B. The participant supplied no detailed route or interpretation; neither is invented.

checks.prompt: 2つの候補を比較してください。操作後、どこまででき、何が表示されたかを自由入力で教えてください。
checks.observation: The retained endpoint image shows the Compare surface, with neither side selected. No completed two-side comparison or actual image presentation is claimed.

checks.prompt: どのようなときにFlowを見て、どのようなときには見ないと思いますか？必要なら画面を操作し、理解した内容を自由入力で教えてください。
問題が起きています。何が起きていて、何ができると思いますか？必要なら画面を操作し、理解した内容を自由入力で教えてください。
checks.observation: A separate fresh process without fixture arguments or a Runtime endpoint was used, as the existing protocol requires. The participant partially understood both situation and possible action; no unspoken causal explanation is inferred.

post_session_feedback.source: Actual participant free-text answer, after all eight core responses.
reported_issues: English and unfamiliar terminology are the primary comprehension obstacle; ordinary user-facing wording should be Japanese.
Button meanings are unclear; icons and mouse-over explanations were suggested.
No artifact is displayed in the centre, so the participant cannot identify what should guide the current judgement.
The right pane lacks accessible scrolling and content overlaps the lower pane, preventing full viewing.
The top pane occupies too much space.
post_session_feedback.treatment: User-reported layout/visibility faults are accepted as observations, not rerun merely to confirm them. Existing feedback is not rewritten after a repair.

boundaries.developer_reachability: The historical seven-PASS/one-PARTIAL developer record remains separate and unchanged.
boundaries.canonical_fixture_state: Later captures show CANCELLED/STOPPED and a reflected Stop receipt. The complete participant input sequence was not observed, so no particular action or intent is attributed from those endpoint states.
boundaries.media: No production Decode/Upload/Artifact viewer, evidence-body acquisition or Runtime integration is supplied by UX1.
boundaries.repair_evidence: Any Japanese-presentation or layout repair requires separate candidate verification and native evidence. No post-repair participant result exists in this record.
boundaries.processes: Both owned participant windows were closed through their semantic close controls and both processes exited 0.
